elements.element: Vendor has an express duty to defend Customer and its affiliates.
elements.evidence: Section 12.c expressly requires TrueLink to “defend” Client and its affiliates.

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims.
elements.evidence: Section 12.c requires TrueLink to indemnify Client and its affiliates against “any third-party claim” within the listed categories.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers claims that Services or Deliverables infringe intellectual property rights.
elements.evidence: Section 12.c(i) covers allegations that the Interface, related software, Hosting Services, or Support Services infringe or misappropriate any intellectual-property right.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's breach of applicable law.
elements.evidence: Section 12.c(ii) covers TrueLink’s violation of any applicable law, rule, or regulation.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers a data breach caused by Vendor.
elements.evidence: Section 12.c(iii) covers unauthorized access to or disclosure of Client Content or Credit Data caused by TrueLink.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
elements.evidence: Section 12.c(iv) expressly covers TrueLink’s gross negligence or willful misconduct.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure requires notice of a claim.
elements.evidence: Section 12.c requires the indemnified party to provide prompt written notice of the claim.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure allocates control of the defence.
elements.evidence: Section 12.c gives the indemnifying party control of the defense and settlement.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure requires reasonable cooperation.
elements.evidence: Section 12.c requires the indemnified party to provide reasonable cooperation in the defense.

elements.element: Customer indemnity is limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.
elements.evidence: Revised Section 12.a limits Client’s indemnity to claims relating to Client Content and Client’s violation of applicable state or federal law, rule, or regulation.

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party intellectual-property claims.
elements.evidence: Section 12.c covers third-party claims alleging that specified TrueLink services or software infringe or misappropriate intellectual-property rights.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer modifications.
elements.evidence: No exclusion for infringement caused by Client modifications is stated.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer combinations.
elements.evidence: No exclusion for infringement caused by Client combinations is stated.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer specifications.
elements.evidence: No exclusion for infringement caused by Client specifications is stated.

elements.element: Vendor must procure continued use, modify, or replace the infringing item.
elements.evidence: The rendered language contains no obligation to procure continued use, modify, or replace an infringing item.

elements.element: Vendor must refund applicable fees if procure, modify, or replace remedies are unavailable.
elements.evidence: The rendered language contains no fallback refund obligation.

elements.element: Vendor's indemnity is subject to a super-cap of three times annual fees.
elements.evidence: No three-times-annual-fees cap or other indemnity super-cap appears in the rendered language.
